messages:
leah.k: seeing a sudden spike in 5xxs and timeouts from mr-prod-2 in us-west-2, started ~17:09 UTC. Customer reports of failed generations rolling in :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: model-runner OOM/segfault surge. Paging oncall: @arnold
arnold (oncall): I'm oncall, pulling logs now. Is this limited to quantized variants or across the board?
devon: quick check: multiple pods OOMKilled then segfaults. Pod example mr-runner-11 logs: 
```
[2024-06-07T17:09:12Z] model-runner: segfault at 0x0 (pc=0x7fffabcd)
[2024-06-07T17:09:13Z] model-runner: GPU OOM while expanding KV cache for seq_len=4096
[2024-06-07T17:09:14Z] kubelet: Pod mr-runner-11 OOMKilled
```
leah.k: looks like kvcache growth from long-context requests. Could be cascade: crash -> traffic shift -> next pod blows.
sasha: Confirmed traffic surge to a handful of heavy customers at ~17:07 UTC. Autoscaler spun identical replicas, so they get same memory profile.
arnold (oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) apply fallback to smaller-context model for heavy routes, 2) throttle long-seq requests at gateway, 3) reduce batch sizes. I'll do 1+2 now.
arnold (oncall): @devon flip route override: p-wizard -> p-wizard-lite for route id 9523
devon: applied: PATCH /routes/9523 {"fallback_model":"p-wizard-lite"} -> 200 OK
ops-bot: Autoscaler action: cordon/drain pods mr-runner-11,mr-runner-12 and recreate with env REDWOOD_KV_MAX=512 (was 2048). Rolling restarts initiated.
sasha: rolling restart in progress. Some shards show error rate decline, others still noisy :eyes:
leah.k: also lowered max batch size for route 9523 to reduce memory pressure.
arnold (oncall): infra command: infra-tool config set route/9523 batch_target=4 -> applied
devon: restarted pod mr-runner-21 logs show kvcache eviction thrash WARN but no segfault yet:
```
[2024-06-07T17:15:01Z] model-runner: kvcache: eviction thrash detected, rate=120/s
[2024-06-07T17:15:02Z] model-runner: applied reduced batch -> memory stabilized
```
leah.k: Customer impact: ~23 API keys saw >50% 5xx during 17:07-17:13 UTC. Most heavy producers now routed to lite model — degraded but functional.
arnold (oncall): Status: mitigation active. 502 rate cluster-wide down from ~18% -> ~3% after overrides. Keeping oncall until 18:30 UTC for observation. Will escalate to eng-runtime for kernel rollback if it recurs.
sasha: preparing short customer note for impacted SLA customers, will include timeline and temporary mitigations.
devon: opened infra PR to change default REDWOOD_KV_MAX for quant kernels to 512: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/582 (WIP).
ops-bot: telemetry update: error spike window 17:07-17:13 UTC, peak 5xx rate 18.3% -> now steady at 2.9% cluster-wide.
arnold (oncall): Follow-ups: postmortem (assign devon), customer comms (assign sasha), runbook update to prevent autoscaler from spinning identical high-kv replicas (assign arnold).
leah.k: noted. Add playbook item to enforce route-level long-seq throttles and emergency fallback switches.
incident-bot: Incident logged: /incidents/1719876543-kvcache-thrash-live-mitig. Runbook created and tasks assigned.
leah.k: thanks team. staying on watch. :thumbsup:
